description: Adversarial critique of a design, given as a description or a screenshot URL, with an optional PRD. Returns findings ranked by severity covering hierarchy, density, affordance, composition, copy, and the first-use / 500th-use / zero-data / huge-data / no-permission / irreversible questions. Call it before presenting a design to a human or handing it to engineering.

value.description: A written description of the design, or an https URL to a screenshot.

context.description: Optional: audience, the single most important action, viewport.

prd.description: Optional brief or PRD. Without one, the review judges against general principles.

name: critique_experience
title: Critique experience
